page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture, providing 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Hardware instructions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and FMA. Cache architecture features 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache.

System memory totals 128.0 GB RAM, adhering to a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio at 4.0 GB per vCPU. The server has no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for system operating disks and primary persistence. Baseline network throughput is rated at 10 Gbps, and no dedicated GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

Benchmark results highlight an architecture optimized for multi-threaded concurrency rather than individual thread speed. Single-core performance metrics, such as the Geekbench single-core score of 995.0, stress-ng single-core score of 1107.99, and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.22 GB/sec, register in the lower tiers. In contrast, parallel capabilities remain consistent within mid-tier brackets, demonstrating a Geekbench multi-core score of 8902.0, PassMark CPU score of 23223.67, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 108.79 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing reflects 96.24 GB/sec read and 48.07 GB/sec write bandwidth on large 256 MB blocks.

Given its balance of high memory allocation and moderate compute throughput, this instance delivers practical resource density without the premium associated with specialized compute-heavy or GPU-accelerated tiers. However, applications requiring low-latency single-thread execution or high local disk IOPS may encounter bottlenecks due to conservative single-core clocks and lack of local NVMe storage. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is suited for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, distributed in-memory caching such as Redis, enterprise web serving clusters, and batch data processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores. It features 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, alongside a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or GPU accelerators, relying on remote block storage for persistence. Benchmark evaluation shows modest single-core throughput, balanced by stable middle-tier multi-threaded execution, as reflected by a multi-core Geekbench score of 8902.0 and PassMark CPU score of 23223.67. Memory bandwidth reaches 96.24 GB/sec on uncached read tests, while Redis operations reach 22.63 million operations per second. The server offers cost-effective multi-threaded density without premium hardware add-ons, making it suitable for scalable web serving, Redis caching, microservices, and general enterprise data workloads.
